name: Airia
source:
[spoiler]An era in which she gathers prostitutes from around the world to establish a nation.
Several decades have passed since her youth, and she has fully matured into a graceful, beautiful woman.
The small brothel that began as the first step toward restoring her homeland has grown to the scale of what can be called an entire nation.
She declares its founding and reclaims her place as princess—Airia.[/spoiler]
Gentle and warm-hearted, she believes in the power of expressing love and dislikes conflict.
